name: @awacloud/oconv
description: Browser-safe document conversion through a versioned pivot IR — docx/odt/xlsx/ods/pptx/odp/pdf to structured Markdown, Markdown to docx/odt/pdf, and docx/odt cross-format pairs, each call returning a machine-readable loss ledger. Zero runtime dependency beyond @awacloud/fw and the @awacloud office packages.

awa._coverageComment: Basis = this package's own src/** rows. The canonical All-files aggregate is dominated by the sibling office packages and @awacloud/fw that src/main.js's modules array composes by design (W0 measured 502 of 535 rows foreign), so it tracks the siblings' tests, not this package's. src/worker.js has no lcov row (it evaluates inside a Worker thread; its guard is tests/worker.integration.test.js). src/write/pdf/_test-runtime.js stays inside the basis (the gate's glob matcher has no negation). 0.95 is the owner-ruled floor, confirmed against the gate's own post-declaration print.

author: Matthieu Bouilloux
